description: One ticker's absorption events for a date (default latest) PLUS its trailing per-day direction history, so you can tell whether today is unusual for the name. Each event carries the absorption strength percentile, the side, the pre-event context quartile and provisional=true when it was detected live without calibration. Forward returns in the history are RAW LONG P&L and are deliberately NOT signed by the absorption side, so a negative number on a sell-absorption day is not a losing signal. Use for 'is NVDA being absorbed, and is that unusual?'. Pro.

ticker.description: Stock or ETF ticker, e.g. NVDA, SPY, BRK.B
